summary: Registers or reuses a fixed-size text-line record. Rejects empty keys (return 0). If the string already exists via StringArrayComparisonSearch, returns 1 without allocating. Otherwise finds a free record slot with RotatingIndexSearchWithThreshold against a5, resets the slot with PerIndexStructFieldResetter, copies the key with sub_587DD0(record+60, a2, 79), NUL-terminates the 79-byte string at record+139, and stores a5/a3/a4 into record+148/+140/+144. Returns 1 on success, 0 on empty input or no free slot. Structural twin of sub_45B5C0 (cluster-copied prelabel). On the frame path; invoked by TextLineWrappingAndRendering.

local_names.a3: first stored per-record value (written to record+140)
local_names.a4: second stored per-record value (written to record+144)
local_names.a5: search threshold for RotatingIndexSearchWithThreshold and value written to record+148
local_names.v9: slot index alias used for the record pointer math

PerIndexStructFieldResetter(v8, v7) resets the chosen slot's fields (receiver v8 is left uninitialized in the decompiled source)

NUL terminator for the capped string: byte v10[139] = 0 (the 79-byte field spans offsets 60..138, with offset 139 as its terminator byte)
Store parameters into the record: *(record + 148) = a5, *(record + 140) = a3, *(record + 144) = a4
